hook.text: Adding tokens to a liquidity pool on Uniswap creates an LP token.

buildup.text: When you deposit ETH and USDC into a pool, you receive an LP token representing your share. Is this a sale of ETH?

discovery.text: Impermanent loss adds another layer: your pool value changes based on price shifts.

twist.text: Some tax software treats LP deposits as taxable; others don't.

climax.text: Liquidity pools represent billions in locked value with zero official tax guidance.

punchline.text: Deposit tokens, get LP token. Is that a taxable event? Nobody knows.

quiz.question: What complicates the tax treatment of liquidity pools?
options: No official IRS guidance on whether deposits are taxable events
